analysis: The trial succeeded with host-evaluated macro validation HR@10 of 0.5300, exceeding the stated 0.505 reference by 0.025 absolute. Category HR@10 was 0.580 Movies_and_TV, 0.590 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.420 Electronics, and 0.530 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remains the weakest category. The result supports further investigation of sampled multiclass ranking, but does not isolate its contribution from the simultaneous architecture and regularization changes. Allocated GPU time was 207.20 seconds. No held-out test result was reported.
code_summary: Trains one independent SASRec model per category with seed 42: 96-dimensional shared item embeddings, learned positional embeddings, two pre-normalized causal transformer blocks, two attention heads, 4× GELU feed-forward layers, dropout 0.3, and jointly learned item biases. Uses length-100 sequences, 20% random-prefix sampling, and cross-entropy over each positive plus 512 shared uniform negatives, capped at 2,048 training tokens per batch. AdamW uses learning rate 0.001, three-epoch warmup, and gradient clipping. Each category retains one checkpoint selected by local validation HR@10, with NDCG as a tie-breaker; training permits up to 200 epochs with early stopping. The generated predictor routes categories and loads exactly one trained checkpoint per category, without ensembling or external scoring components.
